scope: Canonical attempt 2 on public 3.125.1 failed in its live phase; diagnostics are non-qualifying and isolate an environment cross-talk defect in the fixture
preparation: evidence gates, Agents Full refusal, LocalScaffold, Platform 92/92 per mode, Works Debug/Release builds, 200 supporting Release tests, official v3.125.1 commit/tree/tag qualification and five runtime prebuilds all passed

liveResult.failurePoint: WorksSdkRecoveryPipelineSmokeTests.cs:228 four-minute wait for the committed cascade-expiry effect

rootCause.observation: Every other Works -> EventStore workload stream read returned HTTP 500 in about 1 ms without reaching the gateway, which logged only 200 results for the same route
rootCause.probe: diagnostic replay of four keep-alive POSTs through the Works sidecar (dapr-app-id: eventstore) alternated 500/401/500/401
rootCause.daprError: ERR_DIRECT_INVOKE: failed to invoke, id: eventstore, err: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = "transport: authentication handshake failed: tls: first record does not look like a TLS handshake"
rootCause.cause: self-hosted daprd uses mDNS name resolution by default; an unrelated concurrent Tenants AppHost session ran a non-mTLS daprd with app-id eventstore (pid 83657, config /home/administrator/projects/hexalith/tenants/src/Hexalith.Tenants.AppHost/DaprComponents/accesscontrol.yaml), so the Works sidecar round-robined half of its invocations to that foreign sidecar

correction.behavior: each live topology start derives every sidecar configuration from its exact committed/captured bytes plus one run-owned SQLite nameResolution block (busyTimeout 5s, timeout 2s, disableWAL) in an owned temporary directory removed at teardown, mirroring the Builds composition renderer's isolated discovery
correction.firstIsolationAttempt: diag6 used SQLite with default WAL; the Works sidecar failed initialization with SQLITE_BUSY while four sidecars migrated the fresh registry concurrently (diagnostics/diag6/sqlite-init-race.log)

diagnostics.diag1: unchanged consumer, same failure at line 228 (reproduction)
diagnostics.diag4: unchanged consumer with ASP.NET debug logging plus the sidecar probe; same failure
diagnostics.diag6: isolation with WAL; SQLITE_BUSY init race, command submission 500
diagnostics.diag7: isolation with rollback journaling; placement health probe never became healthy within 180 s (environment flake, no fixture assertion reached)
diagnostics.diag8: isolation with rollback journaling; restart/restore fact passed 1/1, 671.787 s, all four Platform starts and the retained start initialized SQLite discovery; non-qualifying because it reused attempt 2's consumer-independent runtime and a separately built consumer
